sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "base_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_json" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_nutrients" ("food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nutrient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("food_id", "nutrient_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_portions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_quantity" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recipe_food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "food_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_slots" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_slot_rules" ("start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "slot_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_slots (id), PRIMARY KEY ("start_minute"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_slots (id), "logged_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tz_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_text" TEXT NULL, "saved_meal_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES saved_meals (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "food_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_entry_nutrients" ("entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nutrient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "nutrient_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "saved_meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "food_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_item_nutrients" ("item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_meal_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nutrient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "nutrient_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "aliases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "phrase" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "saved_meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learned_matches" ("phrase" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_label" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "times_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("phrase"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "measured_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tz_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("source", "source_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "primary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "equipment" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "routine_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "tz_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "routine_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "kcal_estimated" REAL NULL, "kcal_override" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cardio_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tz_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activity_code" TEXT NULL, "activity_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "met" REAL NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "avg_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "kcal_estimated" REAL NULL, "kcal_override" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("source", "source_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "calorie_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NULL, "activity_factor" REAL NOT NULL, "target_kg_per_week" REAL NOT NULL, "exercise_add_back_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, "macro_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "protein_target" REAL NULL, "carbs_target" REAL NULL, "fat_target" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_nutrients" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nutrient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_amount" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "nutrient_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
